programme.title: They Called Him Trinity

programme.title: Requiem for a Gringo

programme.title: Tequila

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War refuses to surrender to the Northerners, and tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter. The odd couple joins forces, and tactics, to exert ultimate vengeance on the men at the fort.
